notes.title: Update 1.6 - Linux
notes.notes: This update fixes issues found by the awesome Linux community, let's hope the game is back to its stable state on Linux!

notes.title: Update 1.6
notes.notes:
The update includes a few notable changes as well as a lot of other minor enhancements.

 [list]
    [*]Fixed the issue where some players saw two portals of the same color
    [*]The game no longer freezes while switching between windows
    [*]Improved ship's physics: it's now spinning together with a moving ground.
[/list]

notes.title: Update 1.5
notes.notes:
In this update we:
[list]
[*]Added a setting to switch between full-screen and windowed mode. The button is available in the main menu, bottom right corner.
[*] Changed In-Game leader-board: it now shows top 15 players. It also shows your position, if you're not one of the top 15 players.
[*]Made a change so that you'll now be transferred to the next chapter once you've completed the last level in the current one.
[*]Made a lot of fixes found during the testing and based on players' feedback.
[/list]

Last, but not least, we'll be adding Linux support!

notes.title: Update 1.4
notes.notes:
This update brings the long awaited Esc button ːsteamfacepalmː and contains a ton of small changes necessary to make the gameplay experience even better.

One very important change we made: based on the players' feedback, we decided to swap Water and Mechanismus chapter. Water is now the last chapter in the game. We believe it should improve the learning curve and make game more fun to play. 
We tried our best to properly migrate your existing game progress, and you shouldn't notice any changes, but please let us know if something doesn't work as expected.
As usual, happy teleporting! ːsteamhappyː

notes.title: Update 1.3
notes.notes:
In this update we smashed some bugs and polished animations. ːsteamhappyː
[list]
[*]Rocks animations are now way smoother and should be on par with other animations.
[*]Based on your feedback we decided to remove the last water chapter for now and bring it back later.
[*]In between levels splash screen no longer shows unusable "Pause" button and the mouse cursor.
[*]The character dies now if it gets smashed between the gears
[/list]

notes.title: Update 1.2
notes.notes: This update brings you improved water performance. Stay dry and let us know if you still experience any issues!

notes.title: Update 1.1
notes.notes:
Hi there,

Some of the users reported, that there's no sound on the first game launch and update 1.1 fixes this issue.

You should be getting the update anytime now.

Happy teleporting!
